# Core Principle

cause → mutation/event → propagation → observable failure

Evidence: - process_item now just delegates to quick_increment (process_item -> quick_increment); - quick_increment calls increment(item["weight"]) with no locking or atomic ops; - try_lock/unlock are imported at top but never used, so no synchronization is present; - run_verified computes expected = sum(i["weight"] for i in items) and raises if get_counter() != expected, exposing the invariant violation.
